name: Ribs
text: A ribcage to wear: it turns a blow, and steers a skeleton toward the Zombie.

name: Flesh
text: Stitched flesh: more body to lose, and a nudge toward the Zombie.

name: Claw
text: A hooked claw, two at most: it sharpens a touch, and steers a Zombie toward the Ghoul.

name: Weapon arm
text: An arm that still holds its blade: it hits harder, and steers a skeleton toward the Bone Warrior.

name: Bow arm
text: An archer's arm: quicker on the feet, and steers a skeleton toward the Skeletal Archer.

name: Skull
text: A skull to think with: more MP, and steers a skeleton toward the Adept.

name: Focus
text: A caster's focus: more MP, and steers the Adept toward the Lich.

name: Wrappings
text: Old bandages, two at most: they turn a blow, and steer the Adept toward the Mummy-Priest.

name: Phylactery shard
text: A shard of a lich's soul cage. Carried, not worn: it asks a lich for the Deathless.

name: Moonstone
text: A stone that holds moonlight. Carried, not worn: it opens the Moonbound without a moon.
